Exception hierarchy for the `evoxc_hf` package.

Every error raised by `evoxc_hf` derives from `HFError`, which itself
derives from `evoxc.core.EVOXCError` so callers can catch the whole evoxc
error surface with a single `except EVOXCError`.

Import-time constraint: this module imports **only** `evoxc.core`. It must never
pull in numpy or the optional dependencies (torch / transformers / iree /
safetensors), so that `import evoxc_hf.errors` stays dependency-free.

## Symbols

- [`HFConfigError`](/api/evoxc-hf/errors/hfconfigerror/) — Malformed or unsupported `config.json`.
- [`HFError`](/api/evoxc-hf/errors/hferror/) — Base class for every error raised by `evoxc_hf`.
- [`HFUnsupportedError`](/api/evoxc-hf/errors/hfunsupportederror/) — A well-formed request outside the v1 support matrix.
- [`HFWeightError`](/api/evoxc-hf/errors/hfweighterror/) — Checkpoint reading, key-mapping, or tensor-shape problem.
